description:
FILED s543q (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-28, CODE 6a1301ed = MAIN-READY-114 + records, v2-16500) by the Rosetta census B (docs/rosetta-plan.md section 6b; #2104).

THE SHAPE (neutral reproducer, run on the tree, perl 5.40.3 vs PCL):

    use constant K => 3;
    my $z = 2;
    print K*$z, " ", K * $z, "\n";

    perl: 6 6
    PCL : PCL: statement dropped at ... line 3: ... -- Bug. Fell through. Missing case: [... 'funcall' ...]   (exit 255 when reached)

TOKENS (vendored PPI): after a bareword `*` followed by `$` is a Cast --

    my $a = K*$z;      Word(K) Cast(*) Symbol($z)          <- what PCL receives
    my $a = K * $z;    Word(K) Operator(*) Symbol($z)      <- right
    my $a = K*2;       Word(K) Operator(*) Number(2)       <- right

PPI cannot know that K is nullary (after an unknown bareword `*$z` may be a glob argument, `foo *$fh`), so this is NOT a PPI
bug in rule 13's sense: the knowledge is PCL's (the `use constant` / `()` prototype table, the same table #2870's fix reads),
like docs/ppi-upstream-bugs.md section 14's user-sub half.  The sibling repair for a Symbol `*name` after a term is
`_repair_glob_multiply` (section 12, s404); this one is `Word(nullary) Cast(*) Symbol` (rule 11: extend the existing pass,
do not add a second).

CHEAP DISCRIMINATING MEASUREMENT (taken): 0556 with spaces around the two `*` after `pi` / `e` is byte-identical to perl
(all three methods' rows) -- its only cause.

PROGRAMS: 0556-Gamma-function.
frequency_reason: Rosetta: 0556-Gamma-function (`sqrt(2*pi*$z)` and `12*e*$z` with `use constant pi => ...; use constant e => ...`)
subject: DROP: `NAME*$var` -- a `use constant` (or other nullary-prototype) name followed by `*` and a variable with no space -- is lexed by PPI as a GLOB CAST `*$var` after a bareword, and PCL drops the statement ("Bug. Fell through"); `NAME * $var` and `NAME*2` are right (Rosetta 0556)
triage_reason: `use constant` and arithmetic are core (constant is a shipped module), IN by docs/supported-subset.md section 3; PCL's prototype table knows NAME is nullary, PPI cannot
